name: 3D Tibi anatomy contact sheets (scripts/anatomy3d-bench.py)
purpose: Renders full-body region, camera, joint, exercise and mode contact sheets, with neutral-clay diagnosis, individual PNGs, hashes and reviewed side-by-side reports.
capabilities: --shade clay isolates surface geometry; cannot stand in for cutaway or activation review
--set regions: 29 views per body; --set review: 316 situations including the existing camera/joint/phase/window/mode sets
--report-only --review <json> records explicit per-case verdicts; changed PNGs, metadata replacement and mismatched camera/pose baselines fail
With --baseline the report shows each reference verdict beside its thumbnail and a pass/known-limit/fail tally for both states

compatibility.runtime: python3.12 or node; ffmpeg where noted
compatibility.notes: One checked Chrome capture at a time under the host lock. Version 0.5.0 reads fig.defaultPose for the current neutral stance; authored-motion defaults and explicit legacy remain distinct. Historical snapshot renderers need their matching pose adapter. Mac rerun pending.

security.notes: Writes only under qa/ or the named output directory.

approval_evidence: 0.5.0, Windows 2026-11-20: the owner rejected the 1.10 shoulder verdict. Current-source captures separate original-pose geometry from the new neutral stance; normal/clay shoulder, rotation, wrist and authored exercise views examined. Capture/report guards pass in the 59-test suite. Historical 316-case evidence remains dated, not a current creative approval. No Mac or G3 approval.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.
